  why is the round limit fatal

␛[38;5;254m❯␛[m ␛[1;38;5;254m␛[m␛[48;5;237m␛[1;38;5;254m␛[m␛[48;5;237m␛[38;5;254;48;5;237mAssistant                                            ␛[m␛[m
    Round exhaustion is fatal in Agent.runRound: the 
    loop returns ErrRoundLimit, and the chat model   
    treats any error from a round as terminal.
